newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Province of Alberta to launch $750 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Province of Alberta to launch $750 mln loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct 29 (LPC) - Administrative agent Royal Bank of Canada, syndication agent CIBC Wood Gundy and documentation agent NatWest Plc will launch a $750 million loan backing the Province of Alberta next week, market sources said.
The credit is split between a $400 million, 364-day, extendible revolver and a $350 million, five-year revolver.
Pricing was not available by press time. A close is slated before the end of November.
